sentences.text: Sireness Oy is a cohort company registered on 2025-09-29 under the industry code 72100, research and experimental development.
A grant or public funding record of EUR 70 000 is dated 2025-04-30, which is earlier than the registration date, and the record does not say how the two relate.
The register shows a start-up notification dated 2025-10-08, and a programme-entry record is dated 2026-02-09.
No EU project, Business Finland decision or public contract is on file, so investment readiness is unknown.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the funding record should be checked at its source before anyone relies on it.
